name: Jaffna

queries.query: site:gov.lk Jaffna cadastral map parcel land registry Sri Lanka official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Registrar General's Department Jaffna Land Registry, its title-registration page naming Jaffna, and the Survey Department's public SLCadastre viewer. The viewer's official JavaScript exposed the live ArcGIS parcel service.

queries.result: First-party Tamil-language discovery found the Registrar General's Department Tamil title-registration page describing the cadastral map and unique title number, and the Land Commissioner General's Department Tamil service FAQ describing official land measurement and plans. No separate Tamil parcel API was exposed; the public parcel viewer is the Survey Department SLCadastre service.

registryBasis: Sri Lanka's Registrar General's Department first-party office data identifies a Jaffna Land Registry in Jaffna district, and the first-party title-registration page lists Jaffna among title-registration offices. The Survey Department's first-party SLCadastre viewer provides public cadastral parcel geometry for the service area.
